@copilot Update this PR directly to fix its failing CI, preserving the Spotless 8.11.0 upgrade and existing behavior. Do not create an additional PR.

The downloaded CI logs for Build pull request run 41649018746 show two failures. Job 125962123887, build / common / examples, fails in the standalone examples/distro build at :smoke-tests:spotlessJavaCheck. Its formatter reports a violation in examples/distro/smoke-tests/src/test/java/com/example/javaagent/smoketest/SmokeTest.java near line 124, where the resource-attribute filter lambda needs the new formatter's layout. Run the standalone build's narrowest spotlessApply task from examples/distro, rather than hand-editing generated formatting. Check other independently built examples affected by this formatter upgrade and apply their own formatter only where needed. Keep these changes formatting-only.

Job 125962125280, build / common / test2 (17, hotspot), fails CamelPropagationUtilTest initialization in :instrumentation:camel-2.20:javaagent-unit-tests:test. CamelPropagationUtilTest.setUp calls GlobalOpenTelemetry.set at line 35 after CamelMessagingAttributesGetterTest.selectors has initialized BaseSpanDecorator through DecoratorRegistry, which calls GlobalOpenTelemetry.get and installs the default global. The log's cause records BaseSpanDecorator.<clinit> -> DecoratorRegistry.<clinit> -> CamelMessagingAttributesGetterTest.request -> selectors. Fix this concrete test-global-state ownership issue with the repository's existing test isolation patterns, resetting GlobalOpenTelemetry before this class registers its propagating instance and cleaning up its global state afterward. Preserve its propagation assertions and production behavior. Exercise CamelPropagationUtilTest together with CamelMessagingAttributesGetterTest and the full Camel unit-test task, not only the propagation class alone; cover the observed preceding global initialization without depending on incidental test order. Do not disable tests, relax assertions, change production behavior, or add broad retries.

The failed CodeQL check 125962636718 reports five alerts on pre-existing code: two disabled-CSRF annotations in the Spring MVC 6 test fixture SecurityConfig.java, two path-expression annotations in javaagent-bootstrap AgentClassLoader.java, and one in muzzle ReferenceCollector.java. The inspected PR patches change formatting only, not those security operations. Do not modify security behavior, add suppressions, or dismiss alerts to make this formatter-upgrade PR green. Report any genuine newly introduced issue with evidence instead.

Read CONTRIBUTING.md and the applicable repository instructions. Run spotlessApply directly before validation, never preliminary spotlessCheck, and use Java 25 for the build with the supported Java 17 test setting where applicable. Validate the standalone distro formatting/build and the affected Camel unit tests with the narrowest applicable commands. Do not use --rerun-tasks, clean, or bypass the build cache for normal validation. Limit changes to the evidenced failures and formatter-required output; retain the existing PR draft/ready state. Do not change PR title or description.

@copilot Rebuild this PR on the latest main after the other PRs have merged. Work on the existing `renovate/main-spotless-packages` branch, not a new branch or PR. Keep the original Spotless version bump and the Camel test-isolation fix, but regenerate all formatting instead of replaying the old formatting commits.

Use JDK 25. Ensure no other coding task is updating this branch. Run these commands from a clean repository root, stopping on any failure or cherry-pick conflict. Preserve main's newly merged behavior when resolving conflicts.

```bash
set -euo pipefail

test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

git fetch origin
old_head="$(git rev-parse origin/renovate/main-spotless-packages)"

git switch renovate/main-spotless-packages
git reset --hard origin/main

git cherry-pick 31424912036f4caed973c9de404c6256509226be
git cherry-pick --empty=drop c397bdd356fc372d6e4cc2be4cd16945424b7ea0

export JAVA_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$(command -v java)")")")"
java -version

./gradlew spotlessApply
./gradlew -p conventions spotlessApply
./gradlew -p benchmark-overhead spotlessApply

./gradlew publishToMavenLocal
./gradlew -p gradle-plugins publishToMavenLocal

init_script="$PWD/.github/scripts/local.init.gradle.kts"
./gradlew -p examples/distro spotlessApply --init-script "$init_script"
./gradlew -p examples/extension spotlessApply --init-script "$init_script"

git diff --check
git --no-pager diff --stat
git add -u
git commit \
  -m "Apply Spotless 8.11.0 formatting" \
  -m "Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>"

git --no-pager diff --stat origin/main...HEAD

git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/renovate/main-spotless-packages \
  "--force-with-lease=refs/heads/renovate/main-spotless-packages:$old_head"
```

Do not cherry-pick the previous formatting commits. Format all distro subprojects, not just smoke-tests. Keep production behavior and test assertions unchanged. Do not change this PR's title, description, or draft/ready state. If the push lease fails, stop rather than overriding someone else's update.
